# Mark II dev package 0565540a: flash failure, then intermittent boot loop

A pre-release development package first failed to flash, then worked, then boot-looped intermittently.

**physical camera; reported fail; partial report; reported hash.**

**Camera:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md) · **Project:** [Caduceus for OM-5](../projects/caduceus-om5.md)

**Firmware:** [om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om5-ii-1100.md) · **Mod build:** dev-0565540a

**Provenance:** maintainer summary. **Reported:** 2026-11-20. **Test date:** Not explicitly recorded.

**Reported/observed package SHA-256:** `0565540a52e09e483573bf59e1d4a62946db944a6364a9a605c4ee8b4a94de73`

## Procedure and coverage

First flash with an unchecked card copy failed. The owner checked the card file's SHA-256 (match), flashed again and used the camera. The same day the camera boot-looped intermittently; power off and on recovered it.

- Startup reliability of this development package; boot and general use were reported working between loops.
- Highlight Tint had no visible effect; the colour wheel swatch changed only every second colour; the Bl/Wh hint overlapped OM's text.

## Limits and assumptions

- The boot loop was not reproduced on demand and its cause is unknown. Upstream's emulator comparison found an early dependency on section 8 in the gamma hook of this package; whether that ran on the camera is unknown.
- The first failed flash is suspected, not confirmed, to be card-copy corruption.
- This is a development package, not v0.2.0-alpha1 (2b3fd53c…), which changed the hook; do not carry the result to the release.
